net_pnl.formula: sum(float(row['net_paper_pnl']) for each admitted validation row)
net_pnl.population: Per numeric config: persisted causal CLOSED PAPER trade rows for the selected symbol/profile that are in the deterministic VALIDATION split and pass every active config threshold.
net_pnl.split: VALIDATION_ONLY; dataset sorted by (entry_boundary_ms, trade_id), first floor(60%) CALIBRATION and remaining rows VALIDATION.
net_pnl.slippage: NO_SECOND_DEDUCTION_IN_SWEEP; foundation adverse slippage is already embodied in persisted simulated fill prices
net_pnl.spread: NO_SEPARATE_SPREAD_TERM_IN_REALIZED_PNL_FORMULA; only any effect already embodied in persisted fill prices is present

profit_factor.formula: sum(value for value in admitted net_paper_pnl if value > 0) / sum(abs(value) for value in admitted net_paper_pnl if value < 0), only when at least one loss exists
profit_factor.population: Exactly the same admitted validation trade population used by net_pnl for that numeric config.
profit_factor.missingness_rule: profit_factor is null when gross_losing_sum_abs is zero, including zero-trade and all-winning configs; no infinity or surrogate is synthesized

ranking.population_definition: All combined expanded-search and adaptive numeric result rows whose evaluation_status is ACCEPTED, after rejecting any row containing a holdout metric key.
ranking.score: expectancy_R DESC, profit_factor DESC, max_drawdown ASC, min(trade_count,20) DESC, symbol_coverage DESC, rank_stability DESC, config_id DESC
ranking.behavioral_deduplication: Applied after numeric ranking; the first ranked member becomes the unchanged representative for each behavioral signature. Metric leaders are selected from all accepted numeric configs with that metric available.

config_proofs.fees_cost_basis: persisted realized_pnl; entry/exit fees deducted upstream; fill-price slippage embodied upstream; no separate sweep-time fee/slippage/spread deduction

explanation: BEST_NET_PNL_CONFIG is one winning validation trade with no losing denominator, so its PF is correctly unavailable. BEST_PF_CONFIG is selected only among numeric configs with non-null PF and is also the canonical leader. The metrics use the same per-config validation population; there is no accounting or reporting mismatch.
